optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits

professionalSummary.text: Senior Project Manager with five years of experience leading plant automation retrofit projects, responsible for planning, tracking, and executing workstreams while maintaining project budgets and coordinating shutdown windows.
professionalSummary.witness: "Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers."

experienceHighlights.text: Managed instrumentation and control-panel workstreams, producing detailed plans, progress reports, and risk registers aligned with the programme's stage-gate methodology.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions."

experienceHighlights.text: Supported plant shutdown windows at four plants, coordinating with plant managers and the project manager of record to ensure safe and timely closures.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Instrumentation workstream plan, progress reports, risk register, and hand-over note for gate three, all documented under the project manager of record's gate submissions.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: the instrumentation workstream plan and progress reports for one retrofit project, the workstream risk register and the hand-over note for gate three, with the programme office's document references as a verification trail; the gate submissions carry the project manager of record's signature."

skills.text: Stage-gate project management, workstream planning, risk register development, plant shutdown coordination, budget tracking within allocated limits.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience managing workstreams, producing gate documentation, and coordinating shutdowns, but do not confirm that the candidate personally signed project charters or held delegated budget authority.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has partial evidence for key responsibilities but lacks confirmation of charter signing and delegated budget control.

role.roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Plant Automation Retrofits

evidence.text: Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers.
evidence.notes: Shows workstream leadership but not explicit charter signing.

evidence.text: Recruiter screen: candidate said he has been 'the senior PM in all but name' on the retrofits and that the projects 'were run by me day to day'; asked which charters or gate submissions he had signed, he said the project manager of record signed them 'because of the org chart'.
evidence.notes: Candidate claims senior PM role but no evidence of signing.

missingEvidence: Evidence that the candidate signed the project charter and stage-gate submissions.

evidence.text: Budget responsibility was limited to the workstream cost tracking against the allocation set by the project manager of record; no delegated spending limit was held.

missingEvidence: Evidence of holding the project budget under delegated limits.

evidence.text: Supported the plant shutdown windows at four plants as the workstream manager on site, with the shutdown plan and the shutdown decisions held by the project manager of record and the plant manager.

Planned and tracked the two workstreams under the programme's stage-gate method, producing the workstream plans, the progress reports and the stage-gate inputs that the project manager of record assembled into the gate submissions.
evidence.notes: Directly supports workstream planning and tracking.

evidence.text: Wrote the workstream boundary notes, the workstream risk registers and the hand-over notes for each stage gate, all filed under the project manager of record's gate submissions.
evidence.notes: Directly supports documentation of boundaries, risks, and hand-over.

supportedClaims.claim: Senior Project Manager with five years of experience leading plant automation retrofit projects, responsible for planning, tracking, and executing workstreams while maintaining project budgets and coordinating shutdown windows.
supportedClaims.witness: "Project engineer, then workstream manager, on the bottling plant automation retrofit programme of a beverage group for five years, running the instrumentation and the control-panel workstreams within retrofit projects run by the programme's project managers."

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate signed the project charter and stage-gate submissions for each retrofit project.
unsupportedClaims.reason: No evidence of charter signing in the provided materials.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Obtain signed charter documents or a formal statement from the programme office confirming the candidate’s signature.

unsupportedClaims.claim: Candidate held delegated spending authority for the entire retrofit project budget.
unsupportedClaims.reason: Materials state budget responsibility was limited to cost tracking against an allocation set by the project manager of record.
unsupportedClaims.requiredFollowUp: Request documentation of delegated budget limits or a budget authority statement.

Evidence of holding the project budget under delegated limits.

interviewSignalRisks.text: Candidate said he has been 'the senior PM in all but name' on the retrofits and that the projects 'were run by me day to day'; asked which charters or gate submissions he had signed, he said the project manager of record signed them 'because of the org chart'.
interviewSignalRisks.recommendedHandling: Verify actual signing authority and clarify role hierarchy with programme office.

followUpQuestions.question: Can you provide copies of the project charters or stage-gate submissions that bear your signature for each retrofit project you led?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Signed charter documents or formal confirmation of signature.

followUpQuestions.question: What was the delegated budget limit you were authorized to spend on the retrofit projects, and can you provide documentation of that authority?
followUpQuestions.evidenceTarget: Budget authority documentation or formal statement.

Verify delegated budget authority and limits.
Assess whether workstream leadership alone satisfies the requirement for project manager of record.

However, critical evidence that the candidate personally signed project charters and held delegated budget authority is missing. Human review is required to determine if workstream leadership suffices for the project manager of record role or if additional evidence is needed.
limitations: Analysis limited to provided resume, work sample, and notes; no external verification of signatures or budget authority.
